images.title: A cup of 200 ml and a drum of 200 l
images.purpose: Show that millilitres are for small amounts and litres for big amounts: a cup holds 200 ml and a drum holds 200 l, with 1 l = 1,000 ml.
images.composition: A rule at the top, a small cup on the left and a big drum on the right with their capacity tags, and the link between the units between them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TITLE at the top centre, y 80: the text ml for small amounts, l for big amounts (52 px, bold, dark #1F2937). CUP on the left, base on y 640: a trapezoid cup 150 px wide at the top and 110 px wide at the bottom, 130 px tall, x 250 to 400, y 510 to 640, filled pale teal #CCE5F2 with a 4 px outline #1F2937, with a small handle ring 40 px across on its right side and a liquid level line 3 px #0072B2 at 40 px below the rim. DRUM on the right, base on y 640: an upright cylinder 240 px wide and 330 px tall, x 900 to 1140, y 310 to 640, filled pale amber #FBE7C0 with a 4 px outline #1F2937, an ellipse 240 by 40 px for its top and two thin ring lines 3 px at y 420 and y 540. TAGS: under the cup, centred at x 325 and y 700, a tag 200 ml (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2); under the drum, centred at x 1020 and y 700, a tag 200 l (44 px, bold, amber-dark #E69F00); each tag is a rounded rectangle 220 by 64 px with a 3 px outline #6B7280. FACT BANNER in the middle, a rounded rectangle 360 by 80 px at x 548 to 908, y 420 to 500, with a 4 px outline #0072B2 containing the text 1 l = 1,000 ml (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: A small amount like a cup is measured in ml and a big amount like a drum in l, and 1 l = 1,000 ml.
images.description: A cup tagged 200 ml and a drum tagged 200 l, with 1 l = 1,000 ml between them.
images.context: Concept image for Litre or Millilitre? It follows the idea of choosing a unit for capacity in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Ask which container can hold 200 l. The slip to watch: reading 200 ml and 200 l as nearly the same capacity.

image_decisions.why: A small cup and a big drum with the same number but different units show why the unit matters.
